description: M8 check script, seed 1, one player, with night mobs: the debug tools make the Big House a Citadel (building 6, level 10, four cannon ports), put a Stables 20 m east (building 7) with two horses (ids 8, 9) and an ox (id 10), a siege kit 20 m west (catapult 11, ballista 12, bronze cannon 13, 20 of each munition and the research), a goblin village 80 m north (its huts include id 20) and steel gear and four clubs in the stock; the Big House trains four warriors (ids 192, 278, 325, 326); the first warrior (id 5) trains in riding at the Stables (60 s, 30 food) and mounts horse 8; the ox is hitched to the catapult and hauls it 40 m north, and horse 9 is hitched to the bronze cannon and hauls it into one of the Citadel's ports on the roof; at dusk the gun kit trains every warrior to fire a musket and crew a cannon, Equip Best gears the four new warriors, two of them (192, 278) go up into the port to crew the cannon and two (325, 326) crew the catapult; the catapult is told to break hut 20 and goes on to break more of the village, which goes to war; the crew fight off the goblins that reach the catapult; through night 0 the port cannon fires at the night mobs, and the rider attack-moves 40 m south-west, where his first blow on a zombie after a straight gallop is a charge (double damage, knocked back); at dawn he rides home and gets down, and his horse walks back to the Stables. Debug threats: 10 goblin village, 50 Stables, 51 siege kit, 52 gun kit, 53 Citadel, 60 on the late night mobs, 90 Morvath, 91 on a late wave. Skill 4 is riding. Moves are world units (8,000 per metre).
